ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(ISBLANK(Cases__c), Cases__c <= 0, ISBLANK(Pieces_Per_Case__c), Pieces_Per_Case__c <= 0, Case_Value__c < 0, ISBLANK(TEXT(Reason__c)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Reason__c,'Other'), ISBLANK(Notes__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter return cases, pieces per case and reason. Explain Other in Return Details.
